FN-NU3QTJT-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 249
Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Representative Danny Garrett
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 03/04/2024
House Bill 249 as introduced would reduce potential income tax receipts to the Education Trust
Fund by an estimated $420,000 annually, beginning in Fiscal Year 2026, by extending the
sunset date of the Alabama Achieving a Better Life Experience (ABLE) savings account
program from December 31, 2025, currently, to December 31, 2030.
Page 1

FN-NU3QTJT-2
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 249
Committee: Finance and Taxation Education Sponsor: Representative Danny Garrett
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 04/24/2024
House Bill 249 as passed the House of Representatives would reduce potential income tax
receipts to the Education Trust Fund by an estimated $420,000 annually, beginning in Fiscal
Year 2026, by extending the sunset date of the Alabama Achieving a Better Life Experience
(ABLE) savings account program from December 31, 2025, currently, to December 31, 2030.
